name: Braced Chainhead
description: Stand with the chain looped over both forearms so either hand can loose it as its partner guards.

name: Joint Triumph
description: A first cast goes high to draw the guard and a second follows low before the guard can settle.

name: Squall Coilend
description: Walk the measured steps of the court so that feet and chain swing in the same paired beat.

name: Parity Spineplate
description: Cross the chain over the line of a cut so that the blade slides down the iron and past the body.

name: Sigilrasp
description: Wrap the foe's weapon arm with one end and the leg with the other and hold both with qi.

name: Entropy Eyelet
description: Draw the chain back on the offbeat of the foe's step so that the foe's own rhythm turns against him.

name: Demolition Hingebar
description: A wide qi-fed sweep of the chain clears the court of every foe standing within its arc.

name: Janglevow
description: Hold two lines of chain across the foe's front and sides until the foe cannot advance or step aside.

name: Eyeletverdict
description: Cast the tip through the narrowest gap in the foe's guard with the whole court's qi behind it.

name: Tenet Segment
description: The school's finishing stroke in which a pair of casts and a wrap run in one gathered beat to end the exchange.

name: Rivetpledge
description: Stand with the chain hanging in two equal lengths from the hands so the reach on each side is the same.

name: Quenched Jangle
description: Throw two casts that cross in the air before the foe so the tips arrive from opposite sides.

name: Bedrock Writhe
description: Take a half step forward and back to test the exact distance at which the tips can touch.

name: Unrivaled Tailblade
description: Tap with two quick segments in alternating hands to hold the foe's guard from rising.

name: Pall Linkpin
description: Extend the chain at the full reach and turn it so a thrust glances off before it nears the body.

name: Rivetseal
description: Wrap the foe once with each hand's chain in opposite turns and the foe's limbs bind together.

name: Despotic Rasp
description: Pull both chains at once in opposite directions to tear the foe's stance in two.

name: Steel Whiplink
description: A thread of qi runs past the chain's end and drives into the foe where the chain cannot quite reach.

name: Storied Slither
description: Both chains sweep in opposite arcs and strike all foes standing in the space between them.

name: Venom Rivet
description: Lay both chains in a cross on the ground so any foot stepping into the middle is caught at once.

name: Triumphant Spineplate
description: Both tips strike the same point from the full reach and break through where one tip would only dent.

name: Harmonious Tenet Eyelet
description: The school's closing stroke where crossing casts bind the foe's arms and a final tip falls through the opening.

name: Steelrivet
description: Stand easy with the chain flowing loose along the ground like a stream that waits.

name: Steel Chainhead
description: Let the cast run out in one smooth flowing motion and rise only at the foe's flank.

name: Rattle Solace
description: Step across the foe's line in short sure strides like crossing a ford one stone at a time.

name: Squalljoint
description: The chain curves around the wielder's body and meets the cut from the side it did not expect.

name: Ruling Jangle
description: The chain clings and winds slowly about the foe's limbs like weed in a current and tightens as he struggles.

name: Entropy Coilend
description: Draw the chain along the foe's own motion and carry him past his mark.

name: Imperial Rivet
description: Throw with qi flowing ahead of the tip like a current so it lands harder than it looks.

name: Demolition Tailblade
description: A surge of qi runs down the chain and floods outward to strike every foe within the court.

name: Statute Segment
description: Spin the chain slowly about the foe until the turning iron drags his footing into the circle.

name: Noble Hingebar
description: Rake the chain along the ground and up through the foe in one scouring pull that tears his stance away.

name: Harmonious Rattle Edict
description: The school's stroke in which the chain flows around every guard and returns in a single closing throw.

name: Steel Linkpin
description: Stand poised and still with the chain hanging from the raised hand like a hawk on its perch.

name: Thunderclap Rasp
description: Rise a hand's breadth and fall into a cast that drops on the foe's shoulder from above.

name: Windborne Joint
description: Hold position on light feet and shift in small arcs as a hawk hangs on the air.

name: Eyeletbenison
description: Lift the eyes and spread the senses to mark every foe in the court before the first cast.

name: Revered Tailblade
description: Swing the chain out like an opening wing and let the swinging iron knock the cut off its path.

name: Rivet Troth
description: The barbed tip clamps on a limb and the chain winds over it like the closing of a talon.

name: Venomrasp
description: Pull the chain home after the stoop with the foe's weapon snagged on its barb.

name: Peerless Slither
description: Drop the barb point first on a steep line so it pierces a raised guard from above.

name: Peerless Hingebar
description: Gather qi in a held breath and plunge the whole chain upon the foe in a single hawk-like fall.

name: Sovereign Whiplink
description: Cast the chain wide overhead so it falls as a net of iron upon every foe beneath.

name: Magnificent Rattle
description: Drive the barb through the foe's armor and heave so that the plates tear away from the body.

name: Volition Coilend
description: The school's stoop in which a barbed cast seizes the foe's guard and a second throw finishes under it.

name: Prism Spineplate
description: Stand with the field of qi spread wide and the chain hanging ready in the middle of it.

name: Vaunted Joint
description: The field of qi feeds the chain as it flies and the tip lands with the whole field's push.

name: Squall Linkpin
description: Glide forward on the field as if on a rising current of the sky with the chain light behind.

name: Immaculate Chainhead
description: Spin the chain so the field condenses into a ring of guard that turns aside blows from every side.

name: Tyrannous Eyelet
description: The field draws the chain around the foe in a single turn and the wrap tightens as he strains.

name: Revelation Linkpin
description: Spread the field through the air and feel any foe that moves within the court as a ripple in the wind.

name: Demolition Writhe
description: Swing the whole field and chain together in a great arc that strikes all within the wielder's sky.

name: Sigiljoint
description: Leave a lane of the field and the chain laid across the ground to close on any foe who crosses it.

name: Prismrattle
description: Throw the field and chain as one needle of force that passes through shield and armor.

name: Orchestral Tenet Rasp
description: The school's final stroke in which the field is gathered then loosed through the chain and closed in a taught sequence.

name: Rivetvow
description: Sit the weight low over the Core so the chain's swing never pulls the wielder from his centre.

name: Squall Writhe
description: Throw with the Core feeding the chain so the tip lands harder than the arm alone could send it.

name: Deluge Whiplink
description: Step on each pulse of the Core so the feet and the chain keep one even time.

name: Jointbenison
description: Listen through the chain for the beat of a foe's Core and the movement it hides.

name: Bedrock Chainhead
description: Turn two rings of chain around the Core's tracks so a blow breaking one is held by the other.

name: Sigilwrithe
description: A twist from the Core winds the chain around the foe in two opposing turns at once.

name: Entropy Whiplink
description: Spin the Core's force through the chain and haul the foe off balance in a long steady pull.

name: Fearless Slither
description: A thread of Core qi runs ahead of the tip and pierces a guard that a plain cast would only touch.

name: Entropy Segment
description: Swing the chain in an orbit about the Core and strike every foe who comes within its turning.

name: Sigileyelet
description: Leave the chain on the ground charged from the Core so it springs up round any foot that enters.

name: Haemal Slither
description: Send the full force of the Core down the chain and break guard shield and stance with one blow.

name: Resonant Tenet Writhe
description: The school's stroke in which twin tracks of Core qi run down the chain in one gathered release.

name: Steel Coilend
description: Stand open to the wind and hold the chain loose at the side to swear the first line of the cast.

name: Steel Jangle
description: Throw straight along the sworn line and let the tip fly without any curve.

name: Deluge Tailblade
description: Pace forward in the wind with the chain trailing and the feet matched to the gusts.

name: Pealrivet
description: Turn on the line already sworn so the chain meets a cut and bears it harmlessly aside.

name: Sigilrattle
description: The chain winds around the foe and the oath holds the wrap fast however the foe may pull.

name: Segment Reliquary
description: Draw the chain back as a gust strikes and the wind drags the foe's weapon arm out of line.

name: Jangle Triumph
description: Send qi along the sworn line so that the tip lands with all the weight of a promise kept.

name: Solar Eyelet
description: Swing the chain out in the open in a wide arc and strike every foe that has come to stand before it.

name: Volition Spineplate
description: Hold the chain taut in a ring about the foe so that he cannot move without breaking the sworn line.

name: Raspdecree
description: Throw with the field wide open and the full oath loaded so that the tip breaks a guard held in defiance.

name: Volition Hingebar
description: The school's sworn closing sequence of straight casts and a held wrap that ends the exchange on one line.

name: Prism Eyelet
description: Stand square along the plateau rim with the chain hanging into the gap below.

name: Bedrock Joint
description: Throw along the line of the rim so the tip skims the edge and strikes a foe walking it.

name: Silken Hingebar
description: Pace the rim in long even strides with the chain held on the open side as a counterweight.

name: Reminiscence Segment
description: Read the wind rising over the rim and judge from its shifts where a foe has stopped.

name: Chainhead Covenant
description: Turn the chain along the rim so that a cut from the inland side slides off toward the drop.

name: Thrall Rasp
description: Wrap the foe and anchor the end on firm ground so the foe is held with the drop at his back.

name: Thunderclap Rivet
description: Haul the hooked chain toward the open air and the foe leans away from the rim and loses his stance.

name: Splendid Rasp
description: A fine thread of qi leads the tip along the rim line and pierces an unready guard.

name: Magmarattle
description: Ride the gale along the rim and sweep the chain across every foe standing on the edge.

name: Venomeyelet
description: Leave a loop of the chain lying along the rim so that foes who step along it fall into its coils.

name: Quenched Slither
description: Hurl the chain with the full gale behind it and drive the foe back over the rim line.

name: Choral Tenet Joint
description: The school's last stroke in which edge casts and a hauling wrap push the foe off the rim line in one beat.

name: Eyeletseal
description: Plant the feet in open ground and speak the oath aloud so the body and the chain stand on it.

name: Steel Tailblade
description: Voice the oath as the chain flies so that cast and word reach the foe together.

name: Janglegrace
description: Stride over open ground with no turn aside and the chain held in a steady line behind.

name: Steeleyelet
description: Hold the chain in a still circle before the body and keep to the oath so the circle does not break.

name: Thrallrattle
description: Wind the chain about the foe's weapon arm and hold the wrap through the whole exchange.

name: Venomjoint
description: Pull the foe forward across the open ground with a hooked chain until he stumbles in the line.

name: Splendid Spineplate
description: Throw the chain wide across the plateau in one stroke and every foe in the open feels the iron.

name: Gloomrattle
description: Stake the chain into the ground and hold the oath so that foes advancing past it lose footing.

name: Prismjangle
description: Drive the tip through the foe's guard with the whole oath spoken in one breath behind it.

name: Harmonious Destiny Rattle
description: The school's stroke in which the spoken oath and a straight cast and wrap are held to one line.

name: Eyeletvow
description: Stand facing the gale with the feet set along the bearing and the chain slack at the side.

name: Linkpin Triumph
description: Hold the bearing steady through the throw so the tip lands where the line pointed.

name: Squall Whiplink
description: Pace along the bearing without veering so the chain and body advance on one line.

name: Squalleyelet
description: Face the blow squarely and swing the chain so that the gale carries the cut past the body.

name: Unbending Rattle
description: Wind the chain about the foe on the line of the bearing and lock the wrap with steady qi.

name: Entropy Spineplate
description: Draw the hooked foe along the bearing so that he comes forward off his chosen line.

name: Valiant Jangle
description: A thread of qi follows the bearing ahead of the tip and finds the narrow gap in the guard.

name: Whiplink Decree
description: Swing the chain along the bearing with the gale behind it and strike every foe in the line.

name: Linkpin Seal
description: Lay the chain across the bearing so that foes who walk the line are caught fast.

name: Coilend Decree
description: Cast along the bearing with the full gale in the qi so that the blow splits shield and guard.

name: Harmonious Writhe
description: The school's closing sequence taken on the gale bearing and held to its line until the exchange is over.

name: Snug Segment
description: Hold the stance in the open with nothing near to lean on or hide behind.

name: Squall Rivet
description: Take the wind's lent speed into the throw so the tip crosses the open ground faster.

name: Squall Jangle
description: Step with the wind and give way to its push so the body moves without strain.

name: Compassionate Rivet
description: Spread the field wide over the bare ground and feel every foe who moves upon it.

name: Pall Joint
description: Yield to the blow with the chain loose and open so the force passes through and away.

name: Thrallrivet
description: Throw the wrap open handed on the wind and let the gust close its turns about the foe.

name: Thunderclap Chainhead
description: Draw the chain through the wind so the foe's own push is taken and turned against him.

name: Magnificent Hingebar
description: Drive a bare thread of qi through the guard with no feint and no cover behind it.

name: Tailblade Triumph
description: Open the field fully and sweep the chain through every foe that stands in the open with the wielder.

name: Shrewd Segment
description: Leave chain on the open ground with the wind holding its loops ready for the next foot.

name: Haemal Eyelet
description: Cast the whole open field down the chain and cleave through whatever stands in the wind's path.

name: Tenetrattle
description: The school's stroke in which the field opens and the chain flies and the wind closes the sequence without any cover.

name: Sturdy Rivet
description: Sit over the Core with the chain loose and speak the oath inwardly to set the stance.

name: Majestic Writhe
description: Throw with the Core's first pulse so that the tip flies on the sworn line with its force.

name: Bedrock Rattle
description: Step with the Core's pulse and the wind's push so that the stride is long and quiet.

name: Jointpledge
description: Hold the chain in a ring fed by the Core and keep the oath so the ring does not waver.

name: Thralljoint
description: Wind the chain about the foe and feed the wrap from the Core so it holds beyond any ordinary strength.

name: Coilend Pledge
description: Draw the hooked foe along the sworn line with a pulse from the Core that outweighs his stand.

name: Steelrattle
description: A thread of Core qi follows the sworn bearing ahead of the tip and pierces the guard.

name: Inferno Whiplink
description: Swing the chain on the sworn line with the Core's push and strike every foe in the open.

name: Tailblade Pledge
description: Hold the chain in a ring fed from the Core so that the foe cannot move without breaking the oath line.

name: Thunderclap Slither
description: Send the Core's whole pulse down the chain and the sworn line cleaves through shield and stance.

name: Volition Rasp
description: The school's closing sequence in which Core qi runs the sworn line from the first cast to the last wrap.
